# MuleSoft Engineering Blog (mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org)
> Dedicated, free, end-to-end MuleSoft engineering blog curated by Niranjan Potter covering 38 practical setup guides updated through November 2026 (Mule 4.9 LTS, Mule 4.13 Edge, DataWeave 2.13 JWT, Java 17, Agent Fabric, MCP, A2A, Omni Gateway 1.15.0, RTF 3.0.41102, and CloudHub 2.0). For full single-file Markdown context, fetch https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/llms-full.txt.

## Trending Late-2026 Guides (Sep – Nov 2026 Releases & Fixes)
- [Mule 4.13 & DataWeave 2.13: Native JWT & JPMS Fix Guide](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/mule-4-13-dataweave-2-13-jwt-jpms-upgrade-guide.html): Upgrade to Mule 4.13 Edge & DataWeave 2.13: sign JWTs natively with dw::util::jwt::HMAC/RSA, fix Java 17 JPMS IllegalAccessException & Studio 7.29.
- [Fix CloudHub DLB 502 TLS Errors & Maven 3.10.0 Builds](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/cloudhub-dlb-tls-502-maven-4-10-4-cicd-fixes.html): Resolve 502 upstream errors after the Oct 31 CloudHub 1.0 DLB TLS cutoff, fix Maven 3.10.0 CI/CD builds with mule-maven-plugin 4.10.4 & RTF TLS.
- [MuleSoft Vibes (Agentforce Vibes) in Anypoint Code Builder: Complete Setup, Skills & MCP Dev Workflows](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/mulesoft-vibes-agentforce-acb-dev-agent-setup.html): Configure MuleSoft Vibes (Agentforce Vibes) inside Anypoint Code Builder (ACB): link your Salesforce Agentforce org, run multi-step integration plans, author reusable skills, and connect MCP context.
- [Anypoint Studio to Anypoint Code Builder (ACB) Migration: .vscode/launch.json, Maven & Debug Playbook](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/anypoint-studio-to-acb-migration-launch-json-guide.html): Migrate existing Mule 4 projects from Anypoint Studio (Eclipse) to Anypoint Code Builder (VS Code) cleanly: convert Run Config VM args to launch.json, fix Maven pom.xml errors, and debug Java 17 flows.
- [MuleSoft Omni Gateway (Flex Gateway v1.14.5) Deep Dive: Custom Rust PDK (api.consumerUri), Redis Tuning & AI Policies](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/mulesoft-omni-gateway-flex-gateway-pdk-redis-guide.html): Configure MuleSoft Omni Gateway (Flex Gateway 1.14.5) in Kubernetes & Docker: tune sharedStorage.redis timeouts, build Custom Rust PDK policies accessing api.consumerUri, and govern REST + MCP + LLM APIs.
- [Anypoint Runtime Fabric (RTF 3.x) on Kubernetes (EKS/AKS): Setup, restartGeneration & Zero-Downtime Upgrades](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/anypoint-runtime-fabric-rtf-3-kubernetes-eks-setup.html): Deploy and run Anypoint Runtime Fabric 3.x (v3.0.41102) on EKS or AKS: configure rtfctl, Helm, local registries, K8s 1.30-1.37 alignment, and declarative spec.lifecycle.restartGeneration rolling restarts.
- [RAML to OpenAPI (OAS 3.1) Migration in MuleSoft: Modular $ref Structure, APIKit & Exchange Governance](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/raml-to-openapi-oas-3-1-modular-migration-mulesoft.html): Convert legacy RAML 1.0 specs to modular OpenAPI 3.0 / 3.1 contracts with clean external $ref files, APIKit scaffolding, Anypoint API Governance, and MCP Bridge readiness.
- [Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360) Zero Copy vs. MuleSoft for Flow & Composer: Enterprise Decision Guide](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/salesforce-data-cloud-zero-copy-vs-mulesoft-flow-composer.html): Architect the modern Salesforce integration stack clearly: know when to use Data Cloud Zero Copy federation, MuleSoft API-Led / MuleSoft for Flow, or MuleSoft Composer (and understand Composer's auto-deactivation rules).
- [Scatter-Gather vs. Parallel For-Each & Zero-Redeploy Dynamic DB Password Rotation in Mule 4](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/scatter-gather-vs-parallel-foreach-dynamic-db-secrets.html): Solve the two most-asked r/MuleSoft engineering questions in one deep guide: Scatter-Gather vs Parallel For-Each internals (and error collection) + zero-redeploy dynamic DB credential rotation.
- [2026 Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Developer & Platform Architect Exam Guide: Changes, Retirements & Study Plan](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/salesforce-mulesoft-certification-roadmap-2026-exam-guide.html): Navigate 2026 MuleSoft certifications hosted on Trailhead: renamed Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Developer exam specs, retired Catalyst & Hyperautomation certs, Platform Architect maintenance, and a 30-day study map.

## AI, Agent Fabric, MCP, A2A, Agentforce & Governance (Flagship Guides)
- [MuleSoft Agent Fabric End-to-End: Agent Registry, Broker, Scanners & Governance](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/mulesoft-agent-fabric-end-to-end-guide.html): Set up MuleSoft's cross-cloud AI control plane over Agentforce, AWS Bedrock, and Vertex AI using Exchange Agent Registry, scanners, .agent Broker scripts, and Model Wallet kill switches.
- [MuleSoft MCP Connector Hands-On: Build an MCP Server & Client in Mule 4](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/mulesoft-mcp-connector-server-client-setup.html): Build an enterprise MCP Server with mule-mcp-connector over Streamable HTTP (/mcp), expose schema-validated tools, wire an MCP Client flow, and test with MCP Inspector.
- [MuleSoft MCP Bridge: Expose Any OpenAPI / Anypoint Exchange API as MCP Tools](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/mulesoft-mcp-bridge-openapi-to-agent-tools.html): Project existing OpenAPI 3.0 & RAML Process APIs in Anypoint Exchange into curated, OAuth-OBO governed MCP tools without writing a single new Mule flow.
- [Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol in MuleSoft: Agent Cards, Delegation & Multi-Cloud Orchestration](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/mulesoft-a2a-protocol-multi-agent-orchestration.html): Implement mule4-a2a-connector 2.0.0 in Mule 4.9 LTS to publish /.well-known/agent.json Agent Cards and coordinate stateful peer agent tasks.
- [Salesforce Agentforce + MuleSoft End-to-End: Topic Center, API Catalog & External Actions Setup](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/agentforce-mulesoft-topic-center-api-actions.html): Link Salesforce and Anypoint Platform, design Topic Center instructions in ACB, sync API Catalog External Services automatically, and inspect Atlas Reasoning traces.
- [MuleSoft AI Chain (MAC), Einstein Trust Layer & Inference Connector: Build Enterprise RAG in Mule 4](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/mulesoft-ai-chain-einstein-inference-rag-setup.html): Compare mule4-aichain-connector, mule4-einstein-ai-connector, and mule4-inference-connector, then build a complete PostgreSQL pgvector + Einstein RAG pipeline in Mule 4.9.
- [Anypoint Flex Gateway AI Policies: Token Rate Limits, Prompt Guardrails, PII Masking & Semantic Cache](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/flex-gateway-ai-policies-llm-guardrails.html): Run Anypoint Flex Gateway as a centralized Enterprise Model Proxy in Docker and Kubernetes with PII masking, prompt defense, semantic caching, and SSE token limits.
- [Testing, Observability & FinOps for MuleSoft AI Agents: OpenTelemetry, MUnit Evals & Cost Guardrails](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/blog/agent-evals-observability-finops-opentelemetry.html): Trace every Agentforce-Broker-MCP-LLM hop with W3C OpenTelemetry gen_ai.* attributes, run MUnit 3 deterministic + golden-dataset CI evals, and enforce kill-switch budgets.

## Core Mule 4 Architecture, CloudHub 2.0, DataWeave & Connectors
- [CloudHub 1.0 to CloudHub 2.0 Migration Guide: Enterprise 10-Point Checklist](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/cloudhub-1-to-2-migration-guide.html): Migrate Mule 4 apps cleanly from CloudHub 1.0 to CloudHub 2.0 Private Spaces with strict port 8081 bindings, ephemeral disk safety, Ingress TLS, and Maven 4.x config.
- [DataWeave 2.0 Performance Tuning: Tail Recursion & Memory Optimization](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/dataweave-performance-tuning-patterns.html): Eliminate JVM OutOfMemoryError and O(n^2) loops in DataWeave 2.0 using @TailRec, off-heap disk buffering, deferred streaming, and groupBy indexed joins.
- [MuleSoft Batch Processing Interview Questions & Architecture (2026 Guide)](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-batch-processing-interview-questions.html): Master Mule 4 Batch Jobs: LMAX Disruptor ring buffers, blockSize & thread tuning, record-scoped variables, Bulk Aggregators, and watermark crash recovery.
- [Anypoint MQ & DLQ Architecture: Interview Questions & Best Practices](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-anypoint-mq-dlq-fifo-interview.html): Design resilient async messaging in Mule 4 using Anypoint MQ FIFO queues, manual ACK/NACK, Object Store v2 idempotency, and automated DLQ replay.
- [Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 in MuleSoft: Complete Interview & Performance Guide](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-salesforce-bulk-api-2-interview.html): Orchestrate high-volume Salesforce ingestions using Bulk API 2.0 jobs, CSV streaming, governor quota isolation (15,000 batches / 150M records), and failure reconciliation.
- [OAuth 2.0 JWT Bearer Token Flow in MuleSoft: Zero-Downtime Key Rotation](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-oauth-jwt-bearer-token-interview.html): Replace fragile passwords and security tokens with RSA-256 OAuth 2.0 JWT Bearer authentication in MuleSoft, complete with OpenSSL setup and zero-downtime key rotation.
- [MuleSoft Scatter-Gather Router: Interview Questions & Error Recovery](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-scatter-gather-interview-questions.html): Master parallel Scatter-Gather execution in Mule 4: reactive thread pool sizing, per-route Try scopes for partial failures, and flattening route outputs cleanly.
- [OpenTelemetry in MuleSoft: Direct Telemetry Export & Distributed Tracing](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-opentelemetry-tracing-observability.html): Configure native OpenTelemetry traceparent context propagation and OTLP gRPC export from Mule 4.9 / CloudHub 2.0 to Datadog, Grafana Tempo, and Splunk.
- [MuleSoft CI/CD Pipeline Guide: Maven Plugin & GitHub Actions (2026)](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-cicd-maven-pipeline-guide.html): Automate Mule 4.9 builds, Parent POM governance, Connected App deployments, 80%+ MUnit coverage gates, and CloudHub 2.0 promotions in GitHub Actions.
- [MuleSoft Terraform Provider Guide: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-terraform-provider-guide.html): Manage Anypoint Business Groups, Environments, CloudHub 2.0 Private Spaces, and API Manager instances declaratively using Terraform.
- [SAP S/4HANA OData vs JCo RFC Connector in MuleSoft: Architecture Guide](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-sap-s4hana-odata-interview.html): Choose cleanly between SAP S/4HANA OData v4 REST and SAP JCo BAPI/tRFC IDocs in Mule 4, including TID idempotency, CSRF handling, and canonical mapping.
- [MuleSoft Snowflake Connector: High-Volume Ingestion & Staging Patterns](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-snowflake-connector-patterns.html): Build fast Snowflake analytics pipelines in Mule 4 using RSA Key-Pair Auth, S3/Blob staging + COPY INTO (instead of slow JDBC row inserts), and streaming reads.
- [Anypoint Partner Manager & B2B EDI X12/EDIFACT: Interview Guide](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-partner-manager-b2b-edi-interview.html): Configure EDI X12 850/810/856 and EDIFACT flows over AS2/SFTP in Anypoint Partner Manager, including automated 997 Functional ACKs and certificate rotation.
- [Reusable MuleSoft Global Error Handler Plugin: Enterprise Architecture](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-reusable-error-handler-plugin.html): Eliminate copy-pasted APIKit & HTTP error boilerplate across 50+ Mule microservices by building a shared Exchange Global Error Handler Plugin.
- [MuleSoft Secure Properties Tool: AES-256-GCM Encryption Playbook](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-secure-properties-encryption-guide.html): Encrypt database passwords, API secrets, and keystores per environment in Mule 4 using AES-256-GCM without committing plaintext secrets to Git.
- [Senior Java Mastery for MuleSoft Developers: JVM, Reactive Engine & Concurrency](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-java-interview-mastery.html): Understand Mule 4.9's Java 17 upgrade, non-blocking CPU_LITE/CPU_INTENSIVE/BLOCKING_IO thread pools, Java Module invocation, and G1GC memory tuning.
- [Top 20 MuleSoft Scenario-Based Interview Questions & Incident Solutions](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-scenario-based-interview-questions.html): Real-world production incident troubleshooting in Mule 4: timeouts, 502 Ingress errors, poison MQ loops, OAuth storms, and zero-loss backpressure.
- [MuleSoft & Salesforce Agentforce: Topic Center Actions (2026 Guide)](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-agentforce-topic-center-actions.html): Quick-reference interview & architecture brief on Salesforce Agentforce Topic Center metadata, Anypoint Exchange API Catalog sync, and flat schema best practices.
- [MuleSoft MCP Connector: Model Context Protocol for Enterprise AI Agents](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-mcp-connector-ai-agents.html): Quick-reference interview brief covering Streamable HTTP MCP servers, JSON Schema tool catalogs, and mutation safety guardrails in MuleSoft.
- [MuleSoft Model Proxy: Semantic Caching & LLM Token Cost Optimization](https://mulesoft.niranjanpotter.dpdns.org/mulesoft-model-proxy-semantic-cache.html): Quick architecture guide on routing enterprise AI traffic through Anypoint Flex Gateway Model Proxy with semantic vector caching and token rate limits.
